title: Alok Kumar v. Dakshinanchal Vidyut Vitran Nigam Ltd.
court: High Court of Judicature at Allahabad
coram: Abhinava Upadhya, J.; Shamim Ahmed, J.
disposition: Writ disposed; bill dispute remitted to Executive Engineer under cl. 6.5.
headnote: Consumer sought a writ directing a corrected electricity bill dated 18 June 2019. Held, a consumer who disputes the bill has the remedy of approaching the Executive Engineer under Clause 6.5 of the Electricity Supply Code, 2005; any such representation shall be considered and appropriate orders passed in accordance with law, as far as possible within one month of presenting a certified copy. Petition disposed of without examining the bill on merits.
facts: Alok Kumar filed a writ petition before the Allahabad High Court against Dakshinanchal Vidyut Vitran Nigam Ltd. and the Executive Engineer, disputing an electricity bill dated 18 June 2019 and seeking a direction that the authorities issue a corrected bill. Counsel for the petitioner and for the distribution licensee were heard by a Division Bench. The order records no prior Clause 6.5 determination of that bill. The petition was disposed of the same day without inquiry into the billed amount.

holding_units.topic: disputed bill — representation to Executive Engineer
holding_units.holding: Where a consumer disputes an electricity bill and seeks a corrected bill in writ jurisdiction, the remedy is a representation to the Executive Engineer under Clause 6.5 of the Electricity Supply Code, 2005; if made, that representation shall be considered and appropriate orders passed in accordance with law, as far as possible within one month of presentation of a certified copy of the order.

principle_tags.application: The writ seeking a corrected bill was not decided on merits; the consumer was sent to Clause 6.5 as the available remedy.
The Court directed that a representation to the Executive Engineer, if made, be considered and appropriate orders passed in accordance with law within about one month.
A prayer for a corrected bill dated 18 June 2019 was treated as a Clause 6.5 billing objection for the Executive Engineer, not a writ to be decided on the amount.

not_decided.point: correctness of the electricity bill dated 18.6.2019 and whether a corrected bill was due
not_decided.note: Writ disposed by remitting the consumer to Clause 6.5 without examining the bill on merits.
